label: leader or organizational head of
definition: X holds or held a leadership/head role in political body or organization Y.
scope_notes: Preserves the previous leader/head scope and includes recognized legislative leadership within a chamber, without requiring sole leadership of the whole body. Head/leader office qualifies; simple membership or founding alone does not.

facts.reason: Gephardt is explicitly a House leader and leader of its majority.
Robertson is explicitly head and leader of Christian Coalition; the founding row is a different predicate.
Arafat is explicitly leader and head of Palestine Liberation Organization across the supplied rows.
Trimble is explicitly head/leader of Ulster Unionist Party and heads it; a challenge from hard-liners is additional context.
Bruno is explicitly a State Senate leader, including its majority leadership.
